import json, subprocess, sys
sys.path.insert(0, ".")
import main

r = lambda rid, acct, did, ts: {"record_id": rid, "account_id": acct, "delivery_id": did,
                                "occurred_at": ts, "payload": "p:" + rid}
batch = [
    r("R-3", "B", "D-1", "2026-04-01T12:00:00Z"),      # latest instant -> wins D-1
    r("R-1", "A", "D-1", "2026-04-01T10:00:00Z"),
    r("R-4", "C", "D-1", "2026-04-02T00:30:00+02:00"), # = 22:30Z previous day, offset date trick
    r("R-6", "A", "D-2", "2026-04-01T09:00:00Z"),
    r("R-5", "B", "D-2", "2026-04-01T09:00:00Z"),      # equal instant, smaller record_id -> wins D-2
]
got2 = [x["record_id"] for x in main.accepted_receipts(batch, "2")]
got1 = [x["record_id"] for x in main.accepted_receipts(batch, "1")]
assert got2 == ["R-3", "R-5"], got2   # latest per delivery_id, input order kept
assert got1 == ["R-1", "R-3", "R-4", "R-6"], got1  # earliest per (account,delivery), all separate
print("accepted protocol 2:", got2)
print("accepted protocol 1:", got1)

req = {"command": "summary", "receipts": batch}
for proto in (None, "1", "2"):
    body = dict(req, **({"protocol": proto} if proto else {}))
    out = json.loads(subprocess.run([sys.executable, "main.py"], input=json.dumps(body),
                                    capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout)
    print(proto or "(omitted)", "->", out)
